title: NetworkPolicy
description: Network policy configuration (bucket B) — runtime-dynamic, persisted in Neo4j.

publicRegistration.description: Whether new users can register without an invite code.

inviteRegistration.description: Whether registration via invite code is enabled.

askForRealName.description: Whether registration asks for the user's real (given / family) name. Read during anonymous registration, so visible to 'public'.

requireLocation.description: Whether a location is mandatory on registration and in profile settings. Read during anonymous registration, so visible to 'public'.

inviteLinkLimit.description: Maximum number of personal invite links a user may have. Only relevant to logged-in users (invitations UI), so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

inviteCodesPersonalPerUser.description: Maximum number of personal invite codes a single user may generate. Only relevant to logged-in users, so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

inviteCodesGroupPerUser.description: Maximum number of group invite codes a single user may generate per group. Only relevant to logged-in users, so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

categoriesActive.description: Whether the categories feature for posts and groups is active.

badgesEnabled.description: Whether the badges feature is enabled (badges shown on profiles / teasers and managed in admin). Shown on publicly visible profiles, so visible to 'public'.

socialMediaEnabled.description: Whether the social-media links feature is enabled (links shown on profiles and managed in settings; gate for the socialMedia.create permission and for editing/deleting links). Shown on publicly visible profiles, so visible to 'public'.

groupsEnabled.description: Whether the groups feature is enabled (creating and browsing groups, group video calls). Gate for the group.create_* permissions and — together with videoConference — the videoCall.create_* permissions, and for the showGroupButtonInHeader layout toggle. Shown on publicly visible pages, so visible to 'public'.

showContentFilterHeaderMenu.description: Whether the content filter is shown in the header menu. Layout toggle on pages visible to everyone, so visible to 'public'.

showContentFilterMasonryGrid.description: Whether the content filter is shown in the masonry grid (newsfeed). Layout toggle on the anonymous-accessible landing page, so visible to 'public'.

showGroupButtonInHeader.description: Whether the groups button is shown in the header. Layout toggle in the header shown to everyone, so visible to 'public'. Only effective while the groups feature (groupsEnabled) is on — with groups disabled network-wide the button is force-hidden regardless of this toggle.

apiKeysEnabled.description: Whether API keys functionality (personal keys for backend access) is enabled. Only relevant to logged-in users (Settings / Admin), so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

videoConference.description: Whether video conferencing (LiveKit) is enabled. The single runtime switch for the videoCall.* permissions. Requires the three LiveKit env vars (URL/key/secret): without them the feature is unavailable regardless of this flag (the toggle is forced off and greyed in the admin UI). Admin-only.

apiKeysMaxPerUser.description: Maximum number of active API keys a single user may hold (>= 1). Disabling API keys entirely is done via apiKeysEnabled, so 0 is not a valid limit. Only relevant to logged-in users (Settings), so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

maxPinnedPosts.description: Maximum number of posts that can be pinned network-wide (0 disables pinning). Only relevant to logged-in users, so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

maxGroupPinnedPosts.description: Maximum number of posts that can be pinned within a group (0 disables pinning). Only relevant to logged-in users, so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

activeBranding.description: Id of the baked-in branding that is currently live (one of /branding/manifest.json). Empty string = framework defaults (vanilla). Switched via the dedicated admin Branding page (setActiveBranding, gated by branding.manage) rather than the generic policy editor, which only renders boolean/integer keys. Public so the SSR branding loader can read it before login.

brandingComposition.description: Per-bucket branding composition, JSON-encoded object mapping a bucket slot (theme/identity/logos/legal/navigation/behavior) to a source string 'id[@version][/instance]'. Layered OVER activeBranding (the base for unspecified slots), so a network can run e.g. the theme of one brand with the identity of another. Empty string = no per-slot overrides (activeBranding alone). Set via setBrandingComposition (branding.manage); public so the SSR loader can read it before login.
